_source: Junttila et al. 2021, Microorganisms 9:1347, DOI 10.3390/microorganisms9071347. Numbers from Table 1 (BGCs by metagenome via fungiSMASH v6.0.0 alpha) and Supplementary Table S3/S4 (assembly + BUSCO Ascomycota).
_notes: BUSCO Ascomycota completeness reported in Junttila2021 Section 3.2 ranges 91.5 - 93.6 % across samples; per-sample exact numbers are taken from the paper text.
BGC and T1PKS counts in 'bgc_count_fungismash' / 't1pks_count_fungismash' are from Table 1, fungiSMASH column.
Outperforming this benchmark means: (a) at least matching these counts AND (b) Hyphae adds calibrated novelty + MIBiG distance, which the paper does not score.

per_sample_accessions._note: Per-sample ENA run accessions under PRJEB34718. Replace with verified accessions when running the live benchmark; pipeline does not depend on these strings.
